user_steps: Create or provide an Azure Storage container to receive the data (required by the FAIRhub workflow).
Log in to FAIRhub through CILogon with institutional credentials (or contact the AI-READI Data Access Committee).
Confirm the research is related to Type 2 diabetes.
Answer the training questions on research methods and ethics.
Describe the research purpose (published with your name on the AI-READI website).
Review and accept the AI-READI Dataset License (DLA, "I ACCEPT").
Select only the CGM, participant table, permitted clinical fields and wearable summaries; provide storage details.
Wait for the request to be processed, then download into data/raw/ai_readi/3.0.0 and run `glucotwin data manifest`.
work_completed_without_access: Open mHealth CGM JSON parser (fictional fixtures)
selective-download planner from a real manifest (fixture-tested)
canonical conversion with LOW/HIGH codes and timestamp anomaly checks

publisher.name: AI-READI (Flagship Dataset of Type 2 Diabetes from the AI-READI Project)
publisher.license: AI-READI custom Data License Agreement (DLA); restricted data require a DTUA and DAC approval
publisher.population: 2,280 participants across disease stages (no diabetes, pre-diabetes, Type 2 diabetes with oral or insulin treatment); not all have usable CGM

datasets.permitted_local_use: Type 2 diabetes related research and AI/ML model training under the accepted DLA. Do not attempt to identify participants. The documentation restricts uploading participant data to third-party LLM providers without the required institutional agreement: process locally only and never place records in prompts, tool output, screenshots or external services.
datasets.redistribution: Not permitted; participant-level files must stay local and git-ignored.

datasets.detail: Discovery resource only. Its harmonized copies overlap CGMacros, ShanghaiT2DM and AI-READI; no component was imported. Catalog totals are never GlucoTwin counts.
